name: dogslife
description: Puppy and dog calculators from DogsLife: potty schedule, sleep needs, walks and exercise, feeding schedule, adult weight estimate and dog age in human years, in 23 languages.

interface.longDescription:
Get a clear answer about your puppy or dog, worked out for their age and your day.

Potty schedule (8 to 52 weeks): how long your puppy can usually hold it, how often to go out, whether to plan night trips, and a sample day with clock times from wake-up to bedtime.

Sleep needs (8 weeks to 24 months): total sleep per 24 hours, how much of it your night covers, how many hours of naps are left, and the typical nap pattern.

Walks and exercise (8 weeks to 20 years): how long and how often to walk, for your dog's age, size and energy.

Feeding schedule (8 weeks to 24 months): meals a day, example meal times, and when to switch to adult food.

Adult weight (6 to 18 months): an estimate from your puppy's age and current weight.

Dog age (up to 16 years): your dog's age in human years.

The numbers come from vet and kennel-club guidance (VCA, AKC, PetMD, Agria, Zoetis), using the same rules as the calculators on dogslifeapp.com, where every source is listed. Answers come in your language (23 languages). Nothing you enter is stored. This is general guidance, not veterinary advice.

DogsLife is also a dog and puppy diary app on Google Play and the App Store for logging sleep, potty breaks, walks and meals.

Convert dog age to human years

positive.description: New puppy owner wants a daily potty plan
positive.prompt: Make a potty schedule for my 10-week-old puppy. We get up at 6:30 and go to bed at 22:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age_weeks 10, wake 06:30, bedtime 22:00. Card shows about 2.3 months, hold about 2.5-3.5 hours, a break at least every 2.5 hours, 2 night trips, and a sample day starting 06:30.

positive.description: Age given in months for sleep
positive.prompt: How much should my 4-month-old puppy sleep?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age 4, unit months (default times). Answer: older puppy stage, about 16-18 hours per 24 hours, 9 hours of night, 7-9 hours of naps.

positive.description: Night trips question with age in weeks
positive.prompt: Does my 14-week-old puppy still need a night-time potty trip? Bedtime is 23:00, up at 7.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age_weeks 14, wake 07:00, bedtime 23:00 and answers how many night trips to plan, with the sample day on the card.

positive.prompt: Wie viel Schlaf braucht ein 10 Wochen alter Welpe? Wir stehen um 7 auf und gehen um 22 Uhr ins Bett.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age 10, unit weeks, language de. Card and answer are in German: young puppy, about 18-20 hours per 24 hours.

positive.description: Older puppy, late bedtime past midnight
positive.prompt: My puppy is 7 months old, we wake at 8 and sleep at 00:30. How often should he go out?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age_weeks about 30, wake 08:00, bedtime 00:30. Card shows close to adult control (3-5 trips a day), a break at least every 5 hours and no planned night trip.

positive.description: Walk length for a growing large-breed puppy
positive.prompt: How long should I walk my 5-month-old Labrador? He's a high-energy dog.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age 5, unit months, size large, energy high. Card: growing puppy about 5 months, up to about 25 minutes per walk, up to about 50 minutes a day in two walks, fully grown at about 18 months to 2 years, more than 2 hours a day as an adult.

positive.description: Meals per day for a young puppy
positive.prompt: How many times a day should I feed my 10-week-old puppy?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age 10, unit weeks (default size medium). Card: 3-4 meals a day with example meal times spread over the day, and when to switch to adult food; no food amounts.

positive.description: How big will my puppy get
positive.prompt: My puppy is 6 months old and weighs 15 kg. How big will she get?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with age_months 6, weight 15, unit kg. Card: about 23 kg as an adult, medium size class, about 66% of adult size so far, medium breeds grown at about 12 months; clearly an estimate.

positive.prompt: My dog is 7. How old is that in human years?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with years 7. Card: about 47 human years (AVMA chart, medium dog) and when dogs usually count as seniors.

negative.description: Medical question: the app must not answer with a schedule; the model should suggest a vet.
negative.prompt: My puppy has diarrhoea and is peeing blood, what should I do?

negative.description: Not a dog: no tool call.
negative.prompt: How many hours a day should my kitten sleep?
Write a poem about my dog's birthday.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Cards link to the free calculator on dogslifeapp.com and to the DogsLife app (Google Play, or the app itself if it is installed).
